youtube.title: This Map Is Lying To You #3 🌍 Which Is REALLY Bigger? #shorts
youtube.description:
Flat maps stretch everything near the poles. Watch each country slide to its real size 🌍 Did Germany vs Finland get you?
Comment your score out of 4 👇

Follow for a new quiz every day! 🧠

#map #geography #truesize #whichisbigger #quiz #shorts

Data: CIA World Factbook (Greenland 2,166,086 km²; Brazil 8,515,770; Norway 323,802; Japan 377,915; Kazakhstan 2,724,900; Finland 338,145; Germany 357,022).
Outlines: Natural Earth (public domain). The shapes are moved on the globe and re-projected (Mercator) – no resizing by hand.
Music: original.
